# Rosemary West

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c13 P7](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0007), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c34 P41](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0041)</sub>
- **Role:** Music teacher  <sub>[v5 c32 P0](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Rosemary West is a tall, fair, and beautiful woman who preserves a remarkable degree of youth. She has warm gold hair pinned in sleek, close coils, large, tranquil blue eyes, a high white forehead, and a finely shaped face.

_Sources: [v5 c13 P7](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0007), [v5 c13 P8](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0008), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009)_

## Personality

Widely regarded as a sweet and placid woman, Rosemary possesses a high-bred, stately air paired with a genuine friendliness. Life has taught her to be brave, patient, loving, and forgiving. She retains an attitude of delighted surprise toward life that lends her a youthful charm. Though capable of small fibs to cover her shyness or confusion, she treats others with deep empathy and warmth.

_Sources: [v5 c13 P7](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0007), [v5 c13 P8](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0008), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009), [v5 c13 P10](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0010), [v5 c13 P11](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0011), [v5 c34 P16](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0016), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)_

## Traits

- Placid and sweet  <sub>[v5 c13 P7](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0007), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009)</sub>
- Brave and patient  <sub>[v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009)</sub>
- High-bred and stately  <sub>[v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009)</sub>
- Empathetic and kind  <sub>[v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching music  <sub>[v5 c32 P0](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To be a supportive friend and helper to John Meredith's children  <sub>[v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)</sub>

## History

At seventeen, Rosemary was engaged to young Martin Crawford, but he perished at sea when his ship was wrecked on the Magdalens. She and her older sister Ellen continued living together in an old gray house on the hill, remaining quite wealthy and distantly related to Leslie Moore. One evening in Rainbow Valley, she met the Glen minister, John Meredith, by a hidden spring and allowed him to walk her home, finding him far more engaging and eloquent than local gossip suggested. Although she loved John Meredith, she initially could not marry him due to a promise made between her and Ellen. Later, after Norman Douglas confronted her in Rainbow Valley to ask her to release Ellen from her pact, Rosemary agreed so her sister could marry Norman. When Una Meredith traveled up the hill to plead with her to marry her father, Rosemary reassured Una that she would not be an unkind stepmother but a loving friend and sister. She then wrote a note to John Meredith requesting to meet him by the spring in Rainbow Valley.

_Sources: [v5 c13 P0](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0000), [v5 c13 P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 c13 P17](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0017), [v5 c13 P19](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0019), [v5 c13 P20](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0020), [v5 c32 P0](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0000), [v5 c32 P12](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0012), [v5 c32 P13](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0013), [v5 c34 P13](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0013), [v5 c34 P17](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0017), [v5 c34 P24](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0024), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031), [v5 c34 P37](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0037), [v5 c34 P44](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0044)_

## Background by volume

- Had a little brother who died long ago and taught her how to make birch cups  <sub>[v5 c13 P15](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0015)</sub>
- Was engaged at seventeen to Martin Crawford, who drowned when his ship wrecked on the Magdalens  <sub>[v5 c13 P0](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0000), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009)</sub>
- Lived closely at the old homestead with her elder sister Ellen after their mother's death  <sub>[v5 c13 P19](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0019)</sub>
- Is distantly related to Leslie Moore

## Quotes

> Will you let me have it? You made it so knackily. I never saw anyone make a birch cup so since my little brother used to make them long ago—before he died.  <sub>[v5 c13 P15](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0015)</sub>

> It is calm to-night. If there were a wind it would blow your breath away. We get ‘a’ the airts the wind can blow’ up here. This place should be called Four Winds instead of the Harbour.  <sub>[v5 c13 P22](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0022)</sub>

> Una, dear, It isn’t because of you poor little souls that I cannot be your father’s wife. I never thought of such a thing. You are not bad—I never supposed you were. There—there was another reason altogether, Una.  <sub>[v5 c34 P17](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0017)</sub>

> I would never dream of trying to turn your father against you. I would love you all dearly. I don’t want to take your own mother’s place—she must always have that in your hearts. But neither have I any intention of being a stepmother. I want to be your friend and helper and chum. Don’t you think that would be nice, Una—if you and Faith and Carl and Jerry could just think of me as a good jolly chum—a big older sister?  <sub>[v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)</sub>
